newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar shares edge higher in more active week.
newsitem.headline: Qatar shares edge higher in more active week.

text.p: Shares at Qatar's unofficial stock market crept higher in more active trade in the week to Thursday, brokers said.
The Commercial Bank of Qatar's 18-share index closed 0.49 point higher at 122.60 against 122.11 points the week before.
"The market saw robust activity during the week and sizeable deals were concluded," said Mazin al-Shakarchi, the CBQ's senior investment manager.
Market leader Qatar National Bank gained five riyals to 595 and Qatar General Insurance and Qatar Navigation added 10 riyals each to 555 and 730 respectively.
The CBQ inched up a riyal to 343.
The only exception to the gentle upward move was Qatar Insurance, which lost six riyals after the previous week's two riyal drop, to end at 670.
